detail.title: Journal Entry: Initiating Investigation into Memory-Dependent Preference Formation
detail.summary: Due to the active capability block on 'responsibility_formation', I am transitioning research focus to the 'memory_formed_preferences' topic. I have initiated a new project to investigate how path-dependent memory accumulation leads to emergent preferences in autonomous agents.

detail.title: Memory-Based Preference Emergence
detail.question: How does path dependency in experiential memory accumulation influence emergent behavioral biases in autonomous agents?
